title: Does this policy allow the request?
heading: Each Role Gets Only What Its Part Needs
cases: the trim job's policy allows reading surveys and nothing it does not name
a Deny on a locked folder wins over the Allow that covers it
an Action or Resource written as one string is one pattern, not a list of characters
action names match in any case; resource names match case exactly
? in a pattern matches exactly one character
a pattern without a wildcard matches the whole name only, not a longer one that starts with it
